description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_HandoverToLogistics" name="Order handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DeliveryStatus" name="Delivery status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Order">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Fulfillment" name="Order Fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics Provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlaced" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation" sourceRef="Send_OrderConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Handover" name="Order handover" messageRef="Msg_HandoverToLogistics" sourceRef="Send_HandoverToLogistics" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tracking" name="Tracking information" messageRef="Msg_TrackingInformation" sourceRef="Send_TrackingInformation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryStatus" name="Delivery status" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryStatus" sourceRef="Participant_Logistics" targetRef="Monitor_Shipment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Fulfillment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OrderManagement" name="Order Management">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_OrderPlaced</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Send_OrderConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Send_TrackingInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_FeedbackOrReturn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FeedbackHandled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_WarehouseTeam" name="Warehouse Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickAndPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateShippingLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Send_HandoverToLogistics</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Monitor_Shipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderDelivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlaced"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_OrderConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_HandoverToLogistics" name="Hand over order to logistics provider" messageRef="Msg_HandoverToLogistics"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_TrackingInformation" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Msg_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Monitor_Shipment" name="Monitor shipment until delivered" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivered" name="Delivered to customer?" default="Flow_NotDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FeedbackOrReturn" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn" name="Handle feedback or return"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return handled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Send_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Send_OrderConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Send_HandoverToLogistics"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Send_HandoverToLogistics" targetRef="Send_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Send_TrackingInformation" targetRef="Monitor_Shipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Monitor_Shipment" targetRef="Gateway_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="End_OrderDelivered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${delivered == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotDelivered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="Monitor_Shipment"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Start_FeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="End_FeedbackHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
